scope: Generic responsibility taxonomy and implementation crosswalk; not a personal case file, repository inventory, task board or service certification.

authorities.task_state: TABVLARIVS; tasks.yaml is a read-only projection

policy.repository_topology: polyrepo; justify each repository boundary independently
policy.unmapped_means: No adequate binding in this bounded review; not evidence of estate-wide absence.
policy.owner_bindings: Accountable functions below are proposed roles, not accepted assignments to people or providers.

responsibilities.label: Education, scholarship & academic practice
responsibilities.outcome: Chosen learning, teaching, research and academic progression are supported.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A chosen educational workflow has an accepted owner, accessible resources, feedback and demonstrated progression.
responsibilities.boundary: Not just a teaching platform; research infrastructure is shared, while disciplinary judgment stays with the domain.

responsibilities.label: Finance & material resources
responsibilities.outcome: Financial obligations, resources and decisions remain legible and support chosen aims.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A reconciled resource and obligation view informs an authorized action and its independently checked result.
responsibilities.boundary: Does not own housing delivery, benefit eligibility, or permission to move money.

responsibilities.label: Health & wellbeing
responsibilities.outcome: Appropriate care, prevention, recovery and everyday wellbeing are accessible.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A chosen care or access need reaches an appropriate provider and follow-up, with consent and a fallback.
responsibilities.boundary: Coordination and information do not confer clinical authority; private records remain outside Git.

responsibilities.label: Law, rights & justice
responsibilities.outcome: Rights, duties, matters and access to qualified legal support are managed.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A matter has an accepted owner, current evidence, deadline handling and an authorized next action.
responsibilities.boundary: Does not substitute for counsel or authorize filings, signatures or representation.

responsibilities.label: Habitat & housing
responsibilities.outcome: Suitable living and working space remains usable, secure and maintained.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A housing need has a viable provider path, resource plan, occupancy or service evidence and continuity arrangements.
responsibilities.boundary: DOMVS computing infrastructure is not evidence of physical housing support.

responsibilities.label: Provisioning & domestic life
responsibilities.outcome: Food, clothing, hygiene, household necessities and daily practical tasks are reliably supported.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A chosen necessity is obtained or practical task completed, with replenishment and fallback responsibility.
responsibilities.boundary: Budgeting and reminders do not prove necessities or assistance were delivered.

responsibilities.label: Labor, career & livelihood
responsibilities.outcome: Work access, conditions, development and sustainable earning capacity are supported.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: One chosen opportunity or workplace need moves through an authorized workflow with an observed outcome.
responsibilities.boundary: Employer-facing HR and consulting do not exhaust personal livelihood; an application is not employment.

responsibilities.label: Enterprise & production
responsibilities.outcome: Ventures, products, customers, partners and productive obligations are coordinated.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: One engagement or product workflow demonstrates delivery, acceptance and obligation reconciliation.
responsibilities.boundary: A service offering is not the whole enterprise; revenue alone is not personal livelihood.

responsibilities.label: Social protection & benefits
responsibilities.outcome: Relevant institutional support is discovered, accessed, maintained and renewed.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A selected support application or renewal has current requirements, an owner and evidence of the actual determination or delivery.
responsibilities.boundary: Approval, eligibility and actual receipt are distinct states; no eligibility inferred from this catalog.

responsibilities.label: Mobility & logistics
responsibilities.outcome: People and necessary belongings can reach the places and services they need.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A chosen journey or movement is feasible, accessible and completed, with a backup route.
responsibilities.boundary: An appointment or message does not establish transport or attendance.

responsibilities.label: Relationships, family & care
responsibilities.outcome: Chosen relationships, reciprocal care and applicable dependent responsibilities are supported.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A person-approved coordination or care need has willing participants, boundaries and a working backup.
responsibilities.boundary: No relationship scoring, contact disclosure or dependent status is inferred from this catalog.

responsibilities.label: Community & civic life
responsibilities.outcome: Chosen participation in communities, associations and public institutions is accessible.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A chosen participation need is supported with access, resources and an observed participation outcome.
responsibilities.boundary: Distinct from internal institutional governance; no political preferences or participation choices are inferred.

responsibilities.label: Culture, creativity, recreation & meaning
responsibilities.outcome: Making, cultural participation, play, rest and freely chosen meaning-making have practical support.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A chosen creative or recreational practice has usable resources and protected participation time.
responsibilities.boundary: No obligation to commercialize, publish, medicalize or credential the activity.

responsibilities.label: Identity & civil administration
responsibilities.outcome: Required identity evidence, civil records, licenses and administrative standing can be maintained.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A chosen administrative requirement is verified, its authorized action completed and renewal responsibility assigned.
responsibilities.boundary: Public presentation and software authentication do not establish civil identity administration.

responsibilities.label: Safety, security & resilience
responsibilities.outcome: Consequential physical and digital risks have prevention, response and recovery arrangements.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A selected risk has an authorized prevention or response path and a safely tested fallback.
responsibilities.boundary: Publication controls are partial reuse, not proof of physical safety or emergency response.

responsibilities.label: Technology & digital life
responsibilities.outcome: Devices, connectivity, accounts, software and accessibility tools remain usable and recoverable.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A selected digital dependency works for the person and recovery is tested without exposing credentials.
responsibilities.boundary: Inference sovereignty and repository custody cover only parts of digital life.

responsibilities.label: Governance, consent & accountability
responsibilities.outcome: Authority, decisions, consent, conflicts and review are explicit.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A bounded action is allowed or denied under an inspectable authority rule, with revocation and review.
responsibilities.boundary: Person-directed support is not unlimited delegated authority; no automatic widening of permissions.

responsibilities.label: Correspondence & communications
responsibilities.outcome: Communication is captured, routed, prepared and delivered under authorized boundaries.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A synthetic communication is routed to its owning matter without duplicate ownership or unauthorized sending.
responsibilities.boundary: The message transport does not own the housing, work, health or other substantive matter.

responsibilities.label: Representation, advocacy & public presence
responsibilities.outcome: Accurate materials and bounded agency support the represented person.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: An evidence-backed packet is prepared with distinct approval for sending, negotiation and commitments.
responsibilities.boundary: Preparing a dossier does not authorize speaking, signing or committing on another person's behalf.

responsibilities.label: Personal operations, strategy & coordination
responsibilities.outcome: Priorities, capacity, commitments, providers and cross-domain handoffs remain coordinated.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: One synthetic multi-domain matter retains one accountable owner through accepted handoffs and verified closure.
responsibilities.boundary: A software task broker is reusable coordination machinery, not proof of available human support.

responsibilities.label: Research, intelligence & foresight
responsibilities.outcome: Decisions draw on traceable sources, explicit uncertainty and revisable interpretation.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A primary/secondary source manifest supports an annotated claim, its domain interpretation and reuse with provenance.
responsibilities.boundary: Observation and traction research are narrower than whole-life research; disciplinary decisions remain domain-owned.

responsibilities.label: Knowledge, records & institutional memory
responsibilities.outcome: Relevant evidence, decisions, provenance and history remain retrievable with appropriate access.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: An authorized reader can retrieve and restore a versioned record with provenance while an unauthorized reader cannot.
responsibilities.boundary: Not a universal shared database; secrets, personal records and raw archives are not public repository content.

responsibilities.label: Transitions, continuity & legacy
responsibilities.outcome: Cross-domain changes, absence, succession and long-term stewardship have workable handoffs.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A synthetic transition or provider-loss exercise preserves responsibilities, records and access through accepted handoffs.
responsibilities.boundary: Agent-session succession is not evidence of whole-life continuity or valid legal instruments.

responsibilities.label: Consulting & advisory engagements
responsibilities.outcome: Expertise can be supplied or obtained through scoped, accountable engagements.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: An engagement identifies direction, scope, acceptance, authority and the domain outcome it serves.
responsibilities.boundary: Provided consulting belongs to enterprise or livelihood; received advice serves whichever domain needs it.

responsibilities.label: Contributions & stewardship
responsibilities.outcome: Useful outward work and stewardship of outstanding contributions remain distinct and traceable.
responsibilities.first_acceptance: A genuinely new outward contribution has a distinct artifact and submission state; outstanding-work stewardship is tracked separately.
responsibilities.boundary: Maintenance, repeated research, internal prototypes and receipts cannot substitute for the daily new contribution; outbound approval is preserved.
